newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's GFT says 1996 sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Italy's GFT says 1996 sales increase.

text.p: Italian textile company GFT SpA on Tuesday reported a rise in 1996 group sales to 1.416 trillion lire after a turnover of 1.391 trillion lire in 1995.
The group issued a statement with the figures after a shareholders meeting to approve its results for 1996.
The group, controlled by HPI, showed 1996 net profits already released earlier of 51.2 billion lire from 18.4 billion lire, and operating profits up up 3.8 percent to 96.7 billion.
At the parent company level, GFT SpA showed a net profit of 10 billion lire in 1996 after a loss of 4.8 billion in 1995.
